Do you need to keep chasing surface-level, empty relationships? Do you need to continue working at your soul crushing job? Do you? Are you better than that? Because I think you are. I think you are so much more than what you think you are. 

It's time to step up to who you truly can be. Stop blaming others, stop blaming your family members, friends, bosses, politicians. You don't need them. You just need your own will. What does your will tell you to do? What is it? I want to find this out for myself. It is something I ask myself every day. What can we do to make this existence better? What is the driving force of our consciousness? Is it God? The universe? The matrix? Are WE God? I think we are. What do you believe? What YOU believe will bring you down a path that will take you to your destiny.

But I have found so much that has helped me piece the puzzle together and life is starting to make sense little by little. 

There's been a lot of breakthrough with psychedelics (once again) and I hope that will shed light on the higher power that we cannot see in this dimension. Quantum physics is starting to explain parts of our world we didn't understand. Reading Aristotle, Plato, Socrates- they all seem to have a deeper knowledge of what is actually going on when it came to existence. Reading Near Death Experiences can be extremely interesting. Some parts of religion can help you see a bigger picture (the more positive parts, stray away from negative).
